title: Monsieur de Fumet
summary: Raleigh names Monsieur de Fumet in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Monsieur de Fumet of France, named with Peter Belonius on the road to Sinai. Not Anthonie Fume. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter IV, §. III, sig. 185b–186a
